Package fr.vborg.sudoku.model

Class Grid

java.lang.Object
fr.vborg.sudoku.model.Grid
public class Grid extends Object
Represents the state of a Sudoku grid.

The grid stores only the values entered in each cell. It does not validate Sudoku rules or perform any user interaction.

Since:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Grid

      public Grid(int size)
      Creates an empty Sudoku grid.

      The size must be greater than or equal to MIN_SIZE and must be a perfect square (4, 9, 16...). This constraint ensures that the grid can be divided into equally sized boxes.

      Parameters:
      size - the grid size
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - the size is invalid

      public int getValue(int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
      Returns the value at the specified row and column.

    • setValue

      public void setValue(int value, int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
      Sets or replaces the value at the specified cell.

      Validation is performed on the cell coordinates and the value range.
      Note : you can also use this method to clear a cell by passing EMPTY as a value.

      Parameters:
      value - the value to affect or replace
      rowIndex - the row index
      columnIndex - the column index

    • getRow

      public int[] getRow(int rowIndex)
      Returns a copy of the row at the specified index.

      The returned array is independent from the internal grid representation. Modifying it does not affect the grid.

      Parameters:
      rowIndex - Row index
      Returns:
      a copy of the row values
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - If the index is invalid

    • getBox

      public int[] getBox(int boxIndex)
      Returns a copy of the box at the specified index.

      Boxes are numbered from left to right and top to bottom.

       +---+---+---+
 | 0 | 1 | 2 |
 +---+---+---+
 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
 +---+---+---+
 | 6 | 7 | 8 |
 +---+---+---+

      The returned array contains the box values in row-major order.

      Parameters:
      boxIndex - box index
      Returns:
      a copy of the box values
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is invalid

    • isComplete

      public boolean isComplete()
      Returns whether the grid is completely filled.

      A complete grid does not contain any EMPTY value.

      Returns:
      true if all cells contain a value, false otherwise
